verdict.rationale: Parsec documents a Teams API for automating deployment and reporting, so automation is a fair axis for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows automations can be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back. Audit logs record activity, which is an adjacent control and does not amount to version history or rollback of automation definitions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
